title: CELESTA International 2026
subtitle: NAZAKAT · Echoes of Awadh: A Symphony of Art, Culture & Heritage
host: City Montessori School, Aliganj Campus I, Lucknow
status_note: The brochure cover states 21–25 August 2026. The programme page has one inconsistent heading reading 25 August 2025; confirm the final programme with the organisers.

events.name: Art and Painting
events.topic: The World I want to See
events.summary: Individual art entry. Participants bring their own materials and colours; drawing paper is provided by the host school.
events.criteria: Artistic skill; quality of artwork; originality; interpretation of the theme; ideas and concepts.

events.name: Mix Media Art
events.summary: Create mixed-media artwork on an A3 sheet. Participants bring materials; recycling and upcycling are the focus. Hazardous materials and power tools are prohibited.
events.criteria: Visual impact; creativity; aesthetic display; clarity in response to theme; originality.

events.name: Choreography
events.summary: Teams of 6–8. Pre-recorded instrumental music is allowed; lyrics-based songs are not. Alaap and shlokas are allowed.
events.criteria: Interpretation of topic; appeal; translation of emotional content of music; natural expression and body language; creativity and originality.

events.name: Traditional Folk Dance
events.topic: Rhythm Roots: Where every step tells a story
events.summary: Teams of 6–8. Traditional folk songs and music are allowed; commercial songs are not. Traditional costumes relevant to the folklore are mandatory.
events.criteria: Authenticity of folk style; costume and cultural representation; energy and rhythm; coordination and group unity; confidence and stage presence.

events.name: Orchestra
events.summary: Teams of 6–10 (8 students and 2 teachers); teachers are not counted in the participant limit. Commercial songs or tunes are not permitted.
events.criteria: Rhythmic interpretation; melody; appeal; originality; creativity.

events.name: Choir
events.summary: 6–8 student singers, with up to 2 teacher accompanists (maximum team size 10). Song may be in any language; commercial or pre-recorded music is not allowed. Lyrics must be submitted in triplicate.

events.name: Harmonic Clash
events.summary: Team of 3: two vocalists and one instrumentalist. English only; original music only. Jingle video must be MP4 and submitted at offline registration.
events.criteria: Rhythm; tonality; originality; coordination; overall performance and showmanship.

events.name: Crescendo (ABRSM)
events.summary: Solo performance of a piece from ABRSM Grade 3 to Grade 5 only. Three copies of notation sheet are required; karaoke or one teacher accompanist is allowed. Formal dress; English performance.
events.criteria: Pitch; accuracy of notes; tempo; selection of song; overall presentation.

events.name: Celesta’s Timeless Frames
events.summary: Submit a portrait photograph. JPEG/JPG/PNG, minimum 2000 pixels on the longest side, 2–10 MB, with a 50–100 word caption. Basic edits only; generative AI images and downloaded/copyrighted images are prohibited.
events.criteria: Originality of concept; relevance of theme; impact; exposure; image quality.

events.name: Celesta Through My Lens
events.summary: Vertical 9:16 MP4/MPEG video, 30 or 60 fps, Full HD, 10–20 MB, with a 50–100 word caption. Generative AI and copyrighted music are prohibited; use royalty-free or self-recorded audio.
events.criteria: Originality of concept; relevance of theme; impact; exposure; video quality.

events.name: 3D Collage
events.topic: Not specified in the visible event detail pages
events.summary: Listed in the brochure’s programme schedule alongside Orchestra as a non-stage event. Detailed rules and evaluation criteria are not available in the schedule text.
events.criteria: Not specified in the available brochure details.
